title: gameStep
responsibility: Advance deterministic independent mechanics and checkpoint actions while preserving progress per game view.

inputs.name: createRun.seed
inputs.description: Initial deterministic random seed normalized to an unsigned 32-bit integer.

inputs.name: createRun.view
inputs.description: Optional built layout whose spawn, level marker and view identity initialize the new run.

inputs.name: stepGame.run
inputs.description: Current deterministic tick, game state, completed checkpoints, events and execution trace.

inputs.name: stepGame.input
inputs.description: Finite movement deltas and optional player branch choice for this fixed tick.

inputs.name: stepGame.view
inputs.description: Active game view containing scene direction and executable checkpoints.

inputs.name: stepGame.mechanics
inputs.description: Independent mechanics to evaluate against the shared tick snapshot and merge disjoint patches.

inputs.name: enterView.run
inputs.description: Current deterministic tick, game state, completed checkpoints, events and execution trace.

inputs.name: enterView.id
inputs.description: Destination view identity whose prior checkpoint progress is restored.

outputs.name: createRun
outputs.description: Fresh deterministic run with empty completion, event and trace lists; a supplied world starts at its planned spawn.

outputs.name: stepGame
outputs.description: Next run after one fixed tick of mechanics and checkpoint evaluation, retaining view-specific progress.

outputs.name: gameStep
outputs.description: Alias of stepGame with the same deterministic update and validation behavior.

outputs.name: enterView
outputs.description: Run retaining global state and restoring the destination view checkpoint completion list.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Movement is non-finite, mechanics write conflicting or unsafe fields, or a planned level lacks a matching human approval and build.
